blocks.text: 把 RPC 调用事件变成有界查询、累计统计、独立录制和离线时间线，并把业务调用与诊断输出的失败分开。

items: 旧事件一淘汰，累计调用数也变小：统计和显示共用同一个事件列表。
清空实时视图后调查证据消失：录制与主查询没有独立保留窗口。
导出的字节和错误原因读不回来：普通 JSON 没有处理字节与 Error 的表示。
录制文件里更早的事件没显示出来：在排序之前先截断了结果。
日志接收端抛错影响了成功调用：诊断回调没有独立报告通道。
只保留最近事件，累计调用数仍持续保留。 保存最近事件的列表与统计分别拥有状态，淘汰旧事件不会从 stats 中减去已经完成的调用，见保留最近调用事件并维持累计调用计数。
清空界面不必丢掉已开始的录制。 record 使用独立容量，clear 只清实时列表与统计，停止录制时仍可导出原窗口，见清空实时视图而不中断已有录制。
离线保存字节和错误原因链。 v1 codec 复用 RPC 错误表示并定义字节标签，读取时恢复字节值与记录中的原堆栈，见往返保存捕获字节与原生错误链。
先按时间排列候选，再限制离线查询数量。 Hub 为合法非单调记录完整排序，不会先截前几行而漏掉更早事件，见先排序非单调录制再限制时间线结果。
脱敏日志与接收端失败都不改变业务结果。 Log probe 从真实 emitter 同步提取独立字段，并把接收端异常送入 onError，见脱敏真实调用日志并隔离日志接收端失败。

blocks.text: Collector 本身就是可装入 Core 的 Probe（同步观察接口），不创建 Peer、transport、持久化存储或文件。defineProbe 的 host 形式把已编译字段附到同一对象并冻结，保留身份；将 collector 传给已有 Endpoint/Peer 的 probe，仍分别管理业务连接和 collector。Core 的直接观察、Peer、managed source 与 pool member 转发复用同一 probe 契约。
Hub 只使用已有 service client 或离线 record，不创建连接、重连监督或业务重试。Log probe 只选择与提取日志字段，缓冲和输出由 logger 拥有。包目前为 workspace-private，peer 依赖 rpc-core/rpc-contract，安装时应直接声明二者；不存在运行时“版本必须相等”的校验。发布保留 dist 与四个入口。

blocks.text: 无效配置使用本包 INVALID_OPTION/TypeError；实际可分配容量仍受宿主内存限制。默认只订阅 message/peer 的逻辑事件；没有默认录制物理帧，也没有隐含 sync/async 摄取模式。
emit(view) 在同步返回前把顶层元数据写入自有原始列，字符串保留引用，不保留 emitter 复用的 view。摄取不进行名称驻留、refcount、carrier 序号翻译或逐 watcher 入队；query、watch 交付、stats、record.stop、export 与 service 在读取边界派生驻留、关联和 wire 表示。不要把可复用 view 留给异步处理。
message/envelope 的可选 variation 保留原 route subtype，例如 ping、pong、close、abort 与已登记的用户名称；abort 的 kind 为 cancel，其余 variation 为 control。request/response 与其它阶段不带此字段，query/watch/wire/录制 codec 保留它。

detail、error 与未实际转移的 captured content 仍是原引用，修改可能影响后续读取；snapshotProbeEvent 也仅复制顶层元数据，不深拷贝这些对象。内容预算按字符串 UTF-8 长度、ArrayBuffer/View.byteLength，或 opaque object 的 view.sizeBytes 计费；未知 sizeBytes=-1 的 opaque object 计 0，不扫描/编码对象图。录制、watch 独立引用不计入主环预算，maxContentBytes 不是进程、全部窗口或任意对象图的总内存上限。

query(input?) 返回 {events,nextSeq,counters}，在保留环单次扫描；nextSeq 是后续 afterSeq 游标，不是数组下标。counters 包含 evicted、contentDropped、droppedReentrant、sampledOut、ignoredWhilePaused、ignoredAfterClose、internOverflow，分别记录事件淘汰、内容丢弃、重入丢弃、采样丢弃、暂停/关闭忽略和名称溢出。

blocks.text: 构造 methods 是摄取过滤；query/watch 的 methods 只匹配实际带该 method 的行，所以 reader 方法过滤不会带上无 method 的 control。读取时名称表满后，新名称使用溢出 id 0 并增加 internOverflow；已有名称继续还原。maxInterned 不限制累计统计保留的原始 endpoint/method 组合，它们直到 clear 才释放，持续增加的唯一组合仍可增长。

只有同时具备非负 durationMs 和 method 的 settled/failed/rejected message 事件才同步更新统计，每个合格事件一次。统计按 endpoint/method 保存 calls、failed、rejected、timedOut、aborted，主环淘汰不清除累计值。failed 包含所有 outcome=failed 的事件，timedOut/aborted 另行增加，因此这些计数不是互斥类别，不能直接相加当总调用数。延迟使用 24 个 log2 桶，边界为 0.0625 ms×2^k（k=0..23）；分位数桶内插值，末桶从 latencyOverflowFromMs=262144 ms 向上开放，p50/p95/p99 钳制到实际 latencyMaxMs，末桶没有固定宽度误差保证。describe.now 与 Core 事件 at 默认使用单调毫秒；stats.since 使用墙上时钟，不能直接当同一时域排序。
pause 保存最新有效 stages 并清空 emitter mask，重复 pause 不覆盖保存值；resume 恢复选择，构造后 setStages 的变化会保留。暂停期间直接 emit 计 ignoredWhilePaused。clear 清主环、累计统计与损失计数，不结束独立录制或 watch；序号继续属于原 collector。

watch(input?) 不接受 afterSeq/limit，首次 next 才激活消费者。活跃 watcher 共用 16384 行原始待通知窗口；每个同步 burst 最多安排一次 microtask 通知，没有活跃 watcher 时不安排通知。原始窗口先保留事件，通知时才执行各 watcher 过滤；每批最多 256 行，每个消费者最多 64 批，过慢时丢最旧批。{events,dropped} 的 dropped 包含筛选前原始覆盖与消费者筛选后批次淘汰，不能还原为精确的过滤命中损失。
原始丢失计数在通知时分发给当时活跃的 watcher；在 burst 通知已安排、尚未交付时首次 next 的 watcher，可能看到订阅前的原始损失。这是当前源码边界，不承诺订阅后精确损失计数。iterator.return 会唤醒自己的挂起 next 并正常结束，不必关闭 collector；collector.close 使等待中的 watch 以 CLOSED 结束。

record({maxEvents?}) 默认沿主环 maxEvents，使用独立环；主环 clear 或淘汰不停止录制，同一时刻只允许一个活动 recording。handle.stop 返回 IRpcDevtoolsRecord，重复 stop 或使用已失去所有权的旧 handle 为 RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE；重复 record 为 RECORD_ACTIVE。collector.close 丢弃未停止的录制，幂等关闭并释放自有状态，不关闭业务 Peer。关闭后 query/stats/describe 与控制操作拒绝 CLOSED，直接 emit 仅计 ignoredAfterClose；exportRecord/importRecord 是纯 codec 入口。

将 devtools.service 放到独立已有 Peer 的 provide:{devtools:devtools.service}，远端方法为 devtools.describe/query/watch/stats/record.start/record.stop/clear/pause/resume；watch 用 Peer.stream 消费。Service record.stop 返回编码文本，普通 handle.stop 返回 record 对象。默认不输出 content；只有 capture 与 exposeContent:true 都按需设置，内容才可能跨线，发布前仍应 redact 并检查访问权限。

Service 使用真实 context.localEndpointId 排除 serving endpoint 的后续采集以及已保留 query/stats 行，不按 devtools.* 方法前缀误删业务。独立 service Peer 避免排除业务 endpoint。远程 watch 取消使用原 stream signal 释放等待。Service 在边界转为 JSON/portable wire：保留序列化 Error 链与 byte 标签，移除 undefined/function 和类 prototype，BigInt 转字符串；不是任意 JS 图无损复制。转换失败抛 TypeError/SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID，原错保留 cause。

RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat 为 {format:'migaia-rpc-devtools',version:1}。encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord(record) 返回 UTF-8 兼容 NDJSON 文本，首行 header，随后每行一个事件并带末尾换行；decodeRpcDevtoolsRecord(text) 接受有或没有末尾换行，内部空行仍非法。事件至少有有限 number 的 seq/at、string 的 endpointId/stage/direction；文件顺序不被 codec 排序或对齐。无效 header/版本/事件/JSON/字节标签使用 RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID/cause，不创建持久化资源。
ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 使用 {$bytes:base64}，在事件任意深度，单键同形对象都是 v1 保留语法，解码为 Uint8Array；非法或非规范 Base64 拒绝。要保留同形普通对象，先 JSON.stringify 为内容字符串，导入后自行 JSON.parse；没有自动转义，也不承诺 content:unknown 任意对象往返无损。

Record.error 输入允许 Error 或已序列化 IRpcWireError；编码复用 RPC 错误 codec，保留 source/code/name/message/stack/cause 与聚合成员，已序列化错误先规范化；解码还原原生 Error，不生成替代 stack。Service wire event.error 保持序列化表示，Hub 离线导入在自己的边界把恢复的 Error 转成同一 wire 形式。

blocks.text: addTarget(name,client) 要求非空唯一名称，client 是已有 request/stream 对象；Hub 调用 request('describe'/'query'/'stats') 与 stream('watch')，不创建连接。若 service 位于 devtools.* 嵌套路径，由调用方 client 边界映射方法名，不在 Hub 新造 Peer。

对齐依次取五次 describe，选 RTT 最小样本：offset=remoteNow-(t0+t1)/2，uncertaintyMs=RTT/2，alignedAt=event.at-offset。依赖往返对称假设，不是无误差时钟；自定义 target 样本必须与事件同一时域，不能把一个样本用于混合时钟。重新对齐仅在全部样本成功后更新已有 timeline 包装，之前取得的引用也会看到新 alignedAt。

初始化先启动唯一 watch 的首次读取，再 afterSeq 分页补历史，每页 1000，之后消费已开始的 watch 并按 seq 去重；只有 collector 原有有界队列。status/on('status') 使用 connecting/connected/disconnected/offline/removed 生命周期值，不是错误码；省略 status 名称返回新状态 Map。on('event') 返回新摄入的已存储包装；listener 失败报告后继续其他监听器。

timeline({targets,stages,trace,method,from,to,limit}) 默认无这些筛选；from/to 按对齐时间，limit 可为非负安全整数，0 返回空。有序 target 环先检查顺序再 k-way merge；合法非单调事件完整排序后应用 limit，最终按 alignedAt、target 名、seq 稳定决定次序，不改文件顺序或原 event 引用。

interactions(trace?) 按显式 trace 和 (senderId,messageId) 关联，不自动传播 trace。oneSided 由请求/响应的业务角色证据决定，不由 target 数决定：同一 target 的两个 endpoint 可证明两侧，重复导入调用方记录不会补出提供方。Hub 不推断缺失事件、不重放业务。stats(name) 转发实时 target 原结果；stats() 汇总计数和直方图桶后重新求分位数，不平均各 target 的 p50/p95/p99；已有最大值保留，旧 target 缺最大值时不伪造。

importRecord(name,text) 创建只读 offline target，alignedAt=原 at，uncertaintyMs=undefined，不恢复录制时偏移。Record v1 不含累计统计，离线 stats 是 {since:0,methods:[]}，汇总不补造离线计数。timeline/interactions 返回数组复用已存储包装与内部事件，detail/error/未转移 content 仍借用引用，不应修改只读结果；codec 才是独立文本表示的边界。

blocks.text: carrierSeq 只引用同一 collector/target 的 carrier 行。Collector 在读取时把 Core 本地序号翻译为 collector 序号，合并主环、录制、watch 仍保留的 origin；摄取时不创建另一套 generation 历史。首次解析前已从所有窗口淘汰的 origin 无法恢复；已知链接在 dependent 仍保留时有效。冷读取发现源序号重置后记录旧 origin cutoff，阻止旧行关联新 generation，历史已知链接仍保留。

Hub 在真实 decode 身份到达后，把同 target 的匿名 protected/frame/carrier 行增量加入 interaction，不改原 wire event，也不混用另一 target 相同 seq。窗口淘汰会同时删除 interaction/trace 索引。部分匿名前序 chunks 仍不能全部归入 interaction；仓库 carrier 在 send 内同步 emit，第三方异步 emit 没有 outbound context。Native Peer 不自动传播应用 trace，需从应用自己的 Endpoint.send 显式传递。Frame/nested transfer 保留引用，detail.drainMs 可在原生 drain 后更新，顶层快照也不深拷贝。
重复 target 名为 TARGET_DUPLICATE，未知名称为 TARGET_UNKNOWN；移除已移除名称幂等。removeTarget 先使目标失效并清索引，再等待其 iterator.return，清理失败报告并原错拒绝。重入 close 会等待已拥有的移除清理，不重复 return；晚到 describe/watch 数据不能复活已移除目标。

describe/query 初始化失败使 target disconnected，报告并以同一原错拒绝 addTarget，已取得 watch 会释放，副清理失败不覆盖主错。运行 watch 中断报告并保留已接收记录，不自动重试；同步 next 失败也不会随后发布 connected。Hub.close 立即封闭新操作，复用同一 Promise，释放所有 owned watch；按登记顺序将失败汇成 TARGET_RELEASE_FAILED AggregateError，cause/errors[0] 为首原错，报告后 resolve。它不关闭已有 client/Peer，关闭后除重复 close 外的公开操作为 CLOSED。

createRpcLogProbe(logger,options?) 要求完整 debug/info/warn/error(message,fields) 四个方法，不依赖 @migaia/logger。默认 stages=['message','peer']；这里只接受这两种阶段。methods/sample 由 Core 同一规则编译，capture/redact 走 emitter 原边界；content 默认 false，content:true 是订阅阶段捕获的便利选项，显式 capture 优先。slowMs 默认 undefined，正常 settled 不记录；显式有限非负值（可 0）使 durationMs≥阈值的 settled 进入 slow。

levels 可覆盖 failed/rejected/timeout/aborted/slow/lifecycle，取 debug/info/warn/error/off。默认 failed→error，rejected/timeout/aborted/slow→warn，lifecycle→info；timeout/aborted 从失败身份识别，不是新增 outcome 字面量。message(view) 默认使用本包分类消息，只在合格事件执行；onError 默认 host reporter。

Log probe 同步提取独立 fields：method/messageId/senderId/targetId/trace/durationMs/outcome/kind/rejection/lifecycle/peerId/error。不会把复用 view 交给异步 logger，error 和显式 content 仍按引用保留，不承诺深快照。每个合格事件同步调用一次 logger；logger 抛错或 thenable 拒绝报告到 onError，不改变业务结果，reporter 失败仍交 host reporter。异步 logger 路径会观察 thenable，普通 collector 业务路径不因此添加 Promise。

Logger 方法必须不阻塞，只入已有队列；本包不另建缓冲、批次、文件、锁、轮转或 flush。使用 @migaia/logger 时，可组合 level、batch、file 并明确 asyncOutput:true，应用负责 await flush/shutdown；Node file 默认异步 append，目录由应用创建，其他宿主需相应 file 能力。示例若直接使用这些入口，应额外直接安装该包；无需为了 log probe 强制依赖它。
错误 source 是 RPC_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE（@migaia/rpc/devtools），code 从 RpcDevtoolsErrorCode 读取，按 source/code 分类，不匹配 message。

blocks.text: 每个代码块作为独立 Node 24 TypeScript 模块执行。所有导入都是公开入口；memory transport 是 Core 的真实载体，record 是完整离线输入。示例不连接外部网络，也不写文件；Endpoint、collector 与 Hub 分别由各自 owner 清理。

sections.id: 保留最近调用事件并维持累计调用计数
sections.heading: 保留最近调用事件并维持累计调用计数

blocks.text: 长期诊断需要保留最近事件，但旧事件离开列表时，累计调用数不能跟着减少。
如果所有统计都从同一个有界事件列表重新计算，列表一淘汰旧记录，累计值也就变小了。
通过 `probePlugin` 把 collector 接到真实 Endpoint；`maxEvents` 限制查询保留量，`stats` 独立累计已经结束的方法调用。
输出：

blocks.code:
2
3
true

blocks.text: 输出 `2`、`3`、`true`：只保留两个最近事件，累计值仍记录三次已完成调用，并且确实淘汰过旧事件。
本例把默认 `10000` 事件容量改为 `2`，只选 `message` 阶段。累计统计保留到 `clear` 才清空；这是保留语义，不是整个进程的内存上限。

collector.stages 本例仅 message，默认是 message/peer；maxEvents 默认 10000，本例 2。query.methods=['double'] 按实际方法筛选，limit 默认 1000、本例 2。memory pair 是真实公开载体，两个 Endpoint 的 id 是 client/server，transport 分别使用 left/right；connect 使用该 Endpoint 的载体，probePlugin 安装 devtools。provider.double 从 context.data 取数并 success 返回两倍，send 明确目标、方法与 data；未装 timeout 时沿 Core 1000 ms 默认。Endpoint dispose 不关闭借用 memory pair，最后 left.close 关闭两侧。

sections.id: 清空实时视图而不中断已有录制
sections.heading: 清空实时视图而不中断已有录制

blocks.text: 操作员要清掉嘈杂的实时视图，但已经开始的录制仍需保留清空之前的调查证据。
显示和录制若共用一份存储，一个看似无害的界面重置就会擦掉录制数据。
给 `record` 单独设置容量，采集真实请求后先清主环，再停止并导出已有录制。
输出：

blocks.code:
0 0
true
true

blocks.text: 输出 `0 0`、`true`、`true`：主环与统计已清空，独立录制仍保留事件，导出文本再导入后事件数一致。
录制容量默认继承 collector 的 `maxEvents`，本例改为 `64`；`clear` 不结束录制，也不重置序号，`stop` 只能成功执行一次，`close` 会丢弃尚未停止的录制。

Endpoint 与 probe 安装同上一场景；record.maxEvents 默认继承主环 2，本例显式 64。echo 返回原 data 42，clear 清主环/统计，不停止录制。recording.stop 成功一次后失去活动所有权；exportRecord/importRecord 仅进行 v1 编解码，不执行文件 I/O。finally 分别关闭 Endpoint、collector 与 memory pair。

sections.id: 往返保存捕获字节与原生错误链
sections.heading: 往返保存捕获字节与原生错误链

blocks.text: 离线诊断文件既要保存字节载荷，也要保留失败操作背后的原始原因。
直接使用普通 JSON 会把类型化字节变成对象字段，并丢掉 Error 的不可枚举属性，导入后的事故信息因此不完整。
把完整 v1 记录交给 `encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord`，再用配套解码器读取，编解码器负责保留字节标签与原生错误图。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true
1,2,3

blocks.text: 输出 `true true`、`true`、`1,2,3`：解码还原 Error 及其 TypeError 原因，保留记录中的堆栈，并还原字节值。
编解码器只转换离线表示，不执行文件读写；单键 `$bytes` 对象属于 v1 保留语法，不保证任意对象、原型和函数都能无损往返。

record.header 使用固定 RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat，事件的 seq/at 是有限数值，endpointId/stage/direction 是必需字符串；content 是 [1,2,3] 字节，error 是带原 cause 的原生 Error。Object.defineProperties 只为本例原错附示意 source/code，不生成运行时控制权限。encode/decode 均只收一个输入参数，恢复的新 Error 保留记录 stack，而不是原对象身份。

sections.id: 先排序非单调录制再限制时间线结果
sections.heading: 先排序非单调录制再限制时间线结果

blocks.text: 导入录制的时间戳并不按事件序号递增，操作员却要查看时间最早的两个事件。
如果先截取两行再排序，就可能显示较晚的事件，把仍在录制中的更早事件漏掉。
把合法录制导入为离线目标，`timeline` 会先排列保留的候选事件，再应用结果数量限制。
输出：

blocks.code:
offline
10,30
true
0

blocks.text: 输出 `offline`、`10,30`、`true`、`0`：取到最早的两个时间，未虚构时钟不确定度，也未替离线事件编造累计统计。
离线 `alignedAt` 就是记录中的 `at`；`maxEvents` 默认每个目标 `50000`，`importRecord` 不创建远程连接，也不启动时钟对齐或周期校时。

encode 的 events 保持文件序号 1..3，at 刻意为 50/10/30，不要求时间单调。Hub options 省略时 maxEvents=50000/target、realignMs=undefined、onError=undefined（默认 console.error）。importRecord 的 saved 是唯一目标名；timeline.targets 筛此目标，limit=2 在全候选排序后生效，默认无 limit。离线 uncertaintyMs 为 undefined，stats 不从事件重算累计值。

sections.id: 标出交互缺失侧而不补造事件
sections.heading: 标出交互缺失侧而不补造事件

blocks.text: 两个诊断文件可能分别记录同一次调用的两侧，缺少其中一个文件时就只能看见单侧。
只按方法名拼接会混合无关调用，自动补齐另一侧又会创造从未观察过的证据。
Hub 按显式 `senderId` 与 `messageId` 关联，并支持 trace 筛选；移除目标会同步更新保留事件的交互索引。

blocks.code:
import { createRpcDevtoolsHub } from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/hub'
import * as format from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/contract'

const outbound = {
  seq: 1,
  at: 10,
  endpointId: 'client',
  stage: 'message',
  direction: 'outbound',
  kind: 'request',
  senderId: 'client',
  messageId: 'call-1',
  method: 'load',
  trace: 'trace-1'
}
const inbound = { ...outbound, at: 11, endpointId: 'server', direction: 'inbound' }
const encode = (event: typeof outbound) =>
  format.encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord({ header: format.RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat, events: [event] })
const hub = createRpcDevtoolsHub()
try {
  hub.importRecord('caller', encode(outbound))
  console.log(hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)
  hub.importRecord('provider', encode(inbound))
  const interaction = hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]
  console.log(interaction?.oneSided, interaction?.targets.join(','))
  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  console.log(hub.status('provider'), hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)
} finally {
  await hub.close()
}

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
true
false caller,provider
removed true

blocks.text: 输出 `true`、`false caller,provider`、`removed true`：单个文件只有一侧，匹配的第二个文件补全已观察到的两侧，移除后又恢复单侧标记。
只有保留的请求与响应角色能证明观察侧；Hub 不自动传播 trace，也不发起业务请求，成功移除的目标可以再次移除，不会重新创建。

两个离线事件共有 senderId=client/messageId=call-1/trace=trace-1，endpointId 和 direction 分别证明调用方与提供方角色；method 名相同本身不足以关联。Hub 依次导入 caller/provider，interactions(trace) 精确筛选已保留记录；removeTarget(provider) 先清索引，再等待自有 watch（本例无远程 watch），重复移除已移除名称幂等。

sections.id: 脱敏真实调用日志并隔离日志接收端失败
sections.heading: 脱敏真实调用日志并隔离日志接收端失败

blocks.text: 诊断需要选定的 RPC 内容，但日志不能泄露原数据，也不能改变本来成功的业务结果。
直接保存可复用的探针视图，会让后续事件覆盖排队中的字段；未处理的日志异常还可能打断调用方。
通过真实 Core 观察路径安装 `createRpcLogProbe`，显式设置 `capture`、`redact`、`onError`，同步提取字段，并单独报告接收端失败。
输出：

blocks.code:
42
true true
true
true true

blocks.text: 输出 `42`、`true true`、`true`、`true true`：请求成功，合格日志使用脱敏对象，每份字段对象独立，所有接收端失败都以原身份报告。
`slowMs` 默认 `undefined`，不记录普通成功调用；本例设为 `0` 以纳入它们。内容捕获默认关闭，脱敏以引用替换内容，缓冲与外部 I/O 由日志接收端负责。

logger 是完整四方法本地接收对象；warn 保存每次独立 fields 并抛同一个 failure，onError 保存原异常。stages 只 message，capture 显式 message（默认无），slowMs=0 纳入成功调用（默认 undefined 不纳入）；redact 返回同一 masked 对象，保留引用而非深快照。levels 未覆盖，slow 默认 warn；真实 Endpoint 的 probePlugin 把该 probe 安装到 Core，不手填事件视图，echo 仍返回 42。

rows: createRpcDevtools 与 collector 类型、错误身份
createRpcLogProbe 与结构化 logger 边界类型

blocks.text: Collector 本身就是可装入 Core 的 Probe（同步观察接口），不创建 Peer、transport、持久化存储或文件。defineProbe 的 host 形式把已编译字段附到同一对象并冻结，保留身份；将 collector 传给已有 Endpoint/Peer 的 probe，仍分别管理业务连接和 collector。Core 的直接观察、Peer、managed source 与 pool member 转发复用同一 probe 契约。
Hub 只使用已有 service client 或离线 record，不创建连接、重连监督或业务重试。Log probe 只选择与提取日志字段，缓冲和输出由 logger 拥有。包目前为 workspace-private，peer 依赖 rpc-core/rpc-contract，安装时应直接声明二者；不存在运行时“版本必须相等”的校验。发布保留 dist 与四个入口。

emit(view) 在同步返回前把顶层元数据写入自有原始列，字符串保留引用，不保留 emitter 复用的 view。摄取不进行名称驻留、refcount、carrier 序号翻译或逐 watcher 入队；query、watch 交付、stats、record.stop、export 与 service 在读取边界派生驻留、关联和 wire 表示。不要把可复用 view 留给异步处理。
message/envelope 的可选 variation 保留原 route subtype，例如 ping、pong、close、abort 与已登记的用户名称；abort 的 kind 为 cancel，其余 variation 为 control。request/response 与其它阶段不带此字段，query/watch/wire/录制 codec 保留它。

detail、error 与未实际转移的 captured content 仍是原引用，修改可能影响后续读取；snapshotProbeEvent 也仅复制顶层元数据，不深拷贝这些对象。内容预算按字符串 UTF-8 长度、ArrayBuffer/View.byteLength，或 opaque object 的 view.sizeBytes 计费；未知 sizeBytes=-1 的 opaque object 计 0，不扫描/编码对象图。录制、watch 独立引用不计入主环预算，maxContentBytes 不是进程、全部窗口或任意对象图的总内存上限。

query(input?) 返回 {events,nextSeq,counters}，在保留环单次扫描；nextSeq 是后续 afterSeq 游标，不是数组下标。counters 包含 evicted、contentDropped、droppedReentrant、sampledOut、ignoredWhilePaused、ignoredAfterClose、internOverflow，分别记录事件淘汰、内容丢弃、重入丢弃、采样丢弃、暂停/关闭忽略和名称溢出。

blocks.text: 构造 methods 是摄取过滤；query/watch 的 methods 只匹配实际带该 method 的行，所以 reader 方法过滤不会带上无 method 的 control。读取时名称表满后，新名称使用溢出 id 0 并增加 internOverflow；已有名称继续还原。maxInterned 不限制累计统计保留的原始 endpoint/method 组合，它们直到 clear 才释放，持续增加的唯一组合仍可增长。

只有同时具备非负 durationMs 和 method 的 settled/failed/rejected message 事件才同步更新统计，每个合格事件一次。统计按 endpoint/method 保存 calls、failed、rejected、timedOut、aborted，主环淘汰不清除累计值。failed 包含所有 outcome=failed 的事件，timedOut/aborted 另行增加，因此这些计数不是互斥类别，不能直接相加当总调用数。延迟使用 24 个 log2 桶，边界为 0.0625 ms×2^k（k=0..23）；分位数桶内插值，末桶从 latencyOverflowFromMs=262144 ms 向上开放，p50/p95/p99 钳制到实际 latencyMaxMs，末桶没有固定宽度误差保证。describe.now 与 Core 事件 at 默认使用单调毫秒；stats.since 使用墙上时钟，不能直接当同一时域排序。
pause 保存最新有效 stages 并清空 emitter mask，重复 pause 不覆盖保存值；resume 恢复选择，构造后 setStages 的变化会保留。暂停期间直接 emit 计 ignoredWhilePaused。clear 清主环、累计统计与损失计数，不结束独立录制或 watch；序号继续属于原 collector。

watch(input?) 不接受 afterSeq/limit，首次 next 才激活消费者。活跃 watcher 共用 16384 行原始待通知窗口；每个同步 burst 最多安排一次 microtask 通知，没有活跃 watcher 时不安排通知。原始窗口先保留事件，通知时才执行各 watcher 过滤；每批最多 256 行，每个消费者最多 64 批，过慢时丢最旧批。{events,dropped} 的 dropped 包含筛选前原始覆盖与消费者筛选后批次淘汰，不能还原为精确的过滤命中损失。
原始丢失计数在通知时分发给当时活跃的 watcher；在 burst 通知已安排、尚未交付时首次 next 的 watcher，可能看到订阅前的原始损失。这是当前源码边界，不承诺订阅后精确损失计数。iterator.return 会唤醒自己的挂起 next 并正常结束，不必关闭 collector；collector.close 使等待中的 watch 以 CLOSED 结束。

record({maxEvents?}) 默认沿主环 maxEvents，使用独立环；主环 clear 或淘汰不停止录制，同一时刻只允许一个活动 recording。handle.stop 返回 IRpcDevtoolsRecord，重复 stop 或使用已失去所有权的旧 handle 为 RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE；重复 record 为 RECORD_ACTIVE。collector.close 丢弃未停止的录制，幂等关闭并释放自有状态，不关闭业务 Peer。关闭后 query/stats/describe 与控制操作拒绝 CLOSED，直接 emit 仅计 ignoredAfterClose；exportRecord/importRecord 是纯 codec 入口。

将 devtools.service 放到独立已有 Peer 的 provide:{devtools:devtools.service}，远端方法为 devtools.describe/query/watch/stats/record.start/record.stop/clear/pause/resume；watch 用 Peer.stream 消费。Service record.stop 返回编码文本，普通 handle.stop 返回 record 对象。默认不输出 content；只有 capture 与 exposeContent:true 都按需设置，内容才可能跨线，发布前仍应 redact 并检查访问权限。

Service 使用真实 context.localEndpointId 排除 serving endpoint 的后续采集以及已保留 query/stats 行，不按 devtools.* 方法前缀误删业务。独立 service Peer 避免排除业务 endpoint。远程 watch 取消使用原 stream signal 释放等待。Service 在边界转为 JSON/portable wire：保留序列化 Error 链与 byte 标签，移除 undefined/function 和类 prototype，BigInt 转字符串；不是任意 JS 图无损复制。转换失败抛 TypeError/SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID，原错保留 cause。

RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat 为 {format:'migaia-rpc-devtools',version:1}。encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord(record) 返回 UTF-8 兼容 NDJSON 文本，首行 header，随后每行一个事件并带末尾换行；decodeRpcDevtoolsRecord(text) 接受有或没有末尾换行，内部空行仍非法。事件至少有有限 number 的 seq/at、string 的 endpointId/stage/direction；文件顺序不被 codec 排序或对齐。无效 header/版本/事件/JSON/字节标签使用 RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID/cause，不创建持久化资源。
ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 使用 {$bytes:base64}，在事件任意深度，单键同形对象都是 v1 保留语法，解码为 Uint8Array；非法或非规范 Base64 拒绝。要保留同形普通对象，先 JSON.stringify 为内容字符串，导入后自行 JSON.parse；没有自动转义，也不承诺 content:unknown 任意对象往返无损。

Record.error 输入允许 Error 或已序列化 IRpcWireError；编码复用 RPC 错误 codec，保留 source/code/name/message/stack/cause 与聚合成员，已序列化错误先规范化；解码还原原生 Error，不生成替代 stack。Service wire event.error 保持序列化表示，Hub 离线导入在自己的边界把恢复的 Error 转成同一 wire 形式。

blocks.text: addTarget(name,client) 要求非空唯一名称，client 是已有 request/stream 对象；Hub 调用 request('describe'/'query'/'stats') 与 stream('watch')，不创建连接。若 service 位于 devtools.* 嵌套路径，由调用方 client 边界映射方法名，不在 Hub 新造 Peer。

对齐依次取五次 describe，选 RTT 最小样本：offset=remoteNow-(t0+t1)/2，uncertaintyMs=RTT/2，alignedAt=event.at-offset。依赖往返对称假设，不是无误差时钟；自定义 target 样本必须与事件同一时域，不能把一个样本用于混合时钟。重新对齐仅在全部样本成功后更新已有 timeline 包装，之前取得的引用也会看到新 alignedAt。

初始化先启动唯一 watch 的首次读取，再 afterSeq 分页补历史，每页 1000，之后消费已开始的 watch 并按 seq 去重；只有 collector 原有有界队列。status/on('status') 使用 connecting/connected/disconnected/offline/removed 生命周期值，不是错误码；省略 status 名称返回新状态 Map。on('event') 返回新摄入的已存储包装；listener 失败报告后继续其他监听器。

timeline({targets,stages,trace,method,from,to,limit}) 默认无这些筛选；from/to 按对齐时间，limit 可为非负安全整数，0 返回空。有序 target 环先检查顺序再 k-way merge；合法非单调事件完整排序后应用 limit，最终按 alignedAt、target 名、seq 稳定决定次序，不改文件顺序或原 event 引用。

interactions(trace?) 按显式 trace 和 (senderId,messageId) 关联，不自动传播 trace。oneSided 由请求/响应的业务角色证据决定，不由 target 数决定：同一 target 的两个 endpoint 可证明两侧，重复导入调用方记录不会补出提供方。Hub 不推断缺失事件、不重放业务。stats(name) 转发实时 target 原结果；stats() 汇总计数和直方图桶后重新求分位数，不平均各 target 的 p50/p95/p99；已有最大值保留，旧 target 缺最大值时不伪造。

importRecord(name,text) 创建只读 offline target，alignedAt=原 at，uncertaintyMs=undefined，不恢复录制时偏移。Record v1 不含累计统计，离线 stats 是 {since:0,methods:[]}，汇总不补造离线计数。timeline/interactions 返回数组复用已存储包装与内部事件，detail/error/未转移 content 仍借用引用，不应修改只读结果；codec 才是独立文本表示的边界。

blocks.text: carrierSeq 只引用同一 collector/target 的 carrier 行。Collector 在读取时把 Core 本地序号翻译为 collector 序号，合并主环、录制、watch 仍保留的 origin；摄取时不创建另一套 generation 历史。首次解析前已从所有窗口淘汰的 origin 无法恢复；已知链接在 dependent 仍保留时有效。冷读取发现源序号重置后记录旧 origin cutoff，阻止旧行关联新 generation，历史已知链接仍保留。

Hub 在真实 decode 身份到达后，把同 target 的匿名 protected/frame/carrier 行增量加入 interaction，不改原 wire event，也不混用另一 target 相同 seq。窗口淘汰会同时删除 interaction/trace 索引。部分匿名前序 chunks 仍不能全部归入 interaction；仓库 carrier 在 send 内同步 emit，第三方异步 emit 没有 outbound context。Native Peer 不自动传播应用 trace，需从应用自己的 Endpoint.send 显式传递。Frame/nested transfer 保留引用，detail.drainMs 可在原生 drain 后更新，顶层快照也不深拷贝。
重复 target 名为 TARGET_DUPLICATE，未知名称为 TARGET_UNKNOWN；移除已移除名称幂等。removeTarget 先使目标失效并清索引，再等待其 iterator.return，清理失败报告并原错拒绝。重入 close 会等待已拥有的移除清理，不重复 return；晚到 describe/watch 数据不能复活已移除目标。

describe/query 初始化失败使 target disconnected，报告并以同一原错拒绝 addTarget，已取得 watch 会释放，副清理失败不覆盖主错。运行 watch 中断报告并保留已接收记录，不自动重试；同步 next 失败也不会随后发布 connected。Hub.close 立即封闭新操作，复用同一 Promise，释放所有 owned watch；按登记顺序将失败汇成 TARGET_RELEASE_FAILED AggregateError，cause/errors[0] 为首原错，报告后 resolve。它不关闭已有 client/Peer，关闭后除重复 close 外的公开操作为 CLOSED。

createRpcLogProbe(logger,options?) 要求完整 debug/info/warn/error(message,fields) 四个方法，不依赖 @migaia/logger。默认 stages=['message','peer']；这里只接受这两种阶段。methods/sample 由 Core 同一规则编译，capture/redact 走 emitter 原边界；content 默认 false，content:true 是订阅阶段捕获的便利选项，显式 capture 优先。slowMs 默认 undefined，正常 settled 不记录；显式有限非负值（可 0）使 durationMs≥阈值的 settled 进入 slow。

levels 可覆盖 failed/rejected/timeout/aborted/slow/lifecycle，取 debug/info/warn/error/off。默认 failed→error，rejected/timeout/aborted/slow→warn，lifecycle→info；timeout/aborted 从失败身份识别，不是新增 outcome 字面量。message(view) 默认使用本包分类消息，只在合格事件执行；onError 默认 host reporter。

Log probe 同步提取独立 fields：method/messageId/senderId/targetId/trace/durationMs/outcome/kind/rejection/lifecycle/peerId/error。不会把复用 view 交给异步 logger，error 和显式 content 仍按引用保留，不承诺深快照。每个合格事件同步调用一次 logger；logger 抛错或 thenable 拒绝报告到 onError，不改变业务结果，reporter 失败仍交 host reporter。异步 logger 路径会观察 thenable，普通 collector 业务路径不因此添加 Promise。

Logger 方法必须不阻塞，只入已有队列；本包不另建缓冲、批次、文件、锁、轮转或 flush。使用 @migaia/logger 时，可组合 level、batch、file 并明确 asyncOutput:true，应用负责 await flush/shutdown；Node file 默认异步 append，目录由应用创建，其他宿主需相应 file 能力。示例若直接使用这些入口，应额外直接安装该包；无需为了 log probe 强制依赖它。
错误 source 是 RPC_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE（@migaia/rpc/devtools），code 从 RpcDevtoolsErrorCode 读取，按 source/code 分类，不匹配 message。

blocks.text: Turn RPC events into bounded queries, cumulative statistics, independent recordings, and offline timelines while keeping diagnostic failures separate from business calls.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Cumulative counts shrink as old events disappear because statistics and display share one bounded list.
Clearing a live view erases investigation evidence because recording has no independent retention window.
Exported bytes and error causes cannot be restored because plain JSON lacks their representation.
An earlier recorded event is missing because results were truncated before sorting.
A failing log sink disrupts a successful call because diagnostics lack a separate failure channel.

Retain recent events without shrinking cumulative call counts. Recent-event storage and statistics own separate state, so eviction does not subtract completed calls from stats, demonstrated in Keep recent RPC events without losing cumulative call counts.

Clear a live view without discarding an active recording. record owns an independent capacity while clear resets only the main ring and statistics, demonstrated in Clear the live view without ending an active recording.

Preserve bytes and native error chains in offline files. The v1 codec reuses RPC error serialization and reserved byte tags, restoring bytes and the recorded stack, demonstrated in Round-trip captured bytes and a native error chain.

Order offline candidates before limiting results. Hub fully sorts valid nonmonotonic records instead of taking an early prefix that can omit earlier events, demonstrated in Sort a nonmonotonic recording before limiting the timeline.

Keep redaction and log-sink failures separate from business results. The log probe extracts independent fields synchronously from the real emitter and reports sink failures through onError, demonstrated in Redact real RPC log fields while isolating a failing sink.

blocks.text: The collector is itself a Core Probe, a synchronous observation interface. It creates no Peer, transport, persistent storage, or file. defineProbe's host form attaches compiled fields to the same object and freezes it without changing identity. Install it on an existing Endpoint/Peer and manage the connection and collector separately. Core observation, Peers, managed sources, and pool members share that probe contract.

Hub accepts existing service clients or offline records; it creates no connections, reconnection supervisor, or business retries. The log probe selects events and extracts fields while the logger owns buffering and output. This workspace-private module has rpc-core/rpc-contract peer dependencies that consumers should declare directly. There is no runtime module-version equality check. Publishing retains dist and the four entries.

blocks.text: Invalid options use this module's INVALID_OPTION TypeError. Actual allocation still depends on host memory. Logical message/peer events are the defaults; physical frames are not implicitly recorded, and ingestion has no separate sync/async mode.

emit(view) consumes top-level metadata into owned raw columns before returning. Strings retain references; the reusable emitter view is not retained. Ingestion performs no name interning, refcount work, carrier-sequence translation, or per-watcher enqueue. Query, watch delivery, stats, record.stop, export, and service boundaries derive names, associations, and wire representations when needed. Never hand a reusable view to asynchronous processing.

Optional message/envelope variation preserves the original route subtype, including ping, pong, close, abort, and registered user names. abort has kind cancel; other variations are control. Request/response and other stages omit it, while query/watch/wire/record codecs retain it.

detail, error, and captured content that was not actually transferred remain references; later mutation can affect reads. snapshotProbeEvent copies only top-level metadata rather than deep-copying those values. Content charges use UTF-8 string length, ArrayBuffer/View.byteLength, or an opaque object's supplied view.sizeBytes. Unknown opaque sizeBytes=-1 costs 0 without traversing or encoding its graph. Recording/watch references are outside the main-ring budget, so maxContentBytes is not a process-wide, cross-window, or arbitrary-object-graph memory bound.

query(input?) returns {events,nextSeq,counters} after one retained-ring scan. nextSeq is the next afterSeq cursor, not an array index. Counters are evicted, contentDropped, droppedReentrant, sampledOut, ignoredWhilePaused, ignoredAfterClose, and internOverflow, recording retention loss, content loss, reentry, sampling, lifecycle ignores, and name overflow.

blocks.text: Construction methods filter ingestion. Query/watch methods match actual method-bearing rows, so a reader method filter excludes methodless control events. When the reader name table fills, new names use overflow id 0 and increment internOverflow; existing names remain readable. maxInterned does not bound cumulative raw endpoint/method keys, which survive until clear and can grow as unique combinations grow.

Only settled/failed/rejected message events containing a method and nonnegative durationMs synchronously update stats, once per qualifying event. Per-endpoint/method calls, failed, rejected, timedOut, and aborted counts survive main-ring eviction. failed includes every outcome=failed event, while timedOut/aborted add separate classifications, so those counters are not disjoint categories to sum into total calls. Latency uses 24 log2 buckets at 0.0625 ms×2^k, k=0..23. Percentiles interpolate inside buckets; the terminal bucket is open above latencyOverflowFromMs=262144 ms, and p50/p95/p99 are clamped to observed latencyMaxMs. There is no fixed-width terminal-bucket error guarantee. describe.now and Core event at use monotonic milliseconds by default, whereas stats.since is wall time.

pause saves current stages and clears the emitter mask; repeated pause does not overwrite that choice. resume restores it, including stages set after construction. Direct emit during pause increments ignoredWhilePaused. clear resets the main ring, cumulative stats, and loss counters without ending independent recording/watch ownership; sequence numbers remain collector-owned.

watch(input?) omits afterSeq/limit and activates a consumer on first next. Active watchers share a 16384-row raw pending window. Each synchronous burst schedules at most one microtask notification; no active watchers means no notification. The raw window retains rows before notification applies each watcher's filters. Batches contain at most 256 events, with at most 64 queued batches per consumer; overflow drops the oldest batch. In {events,dropped}, dropped combines pre-filter raw overwrite and post-filter consumer batch loss, so it cannot reconstruct exact filter-matching loss.

Raw loss is assigned to watchers active at notification time. A watcher whose first next occurs after a burst was scheduled but before delivery can see pre-subscription raw loss. This is a current source limitation rather than a promise of exact post-subscription accounting. iterator.return wakes its own pending next and ends normally without closing the collector; collector.close terminates waiting watches with CLOSED.

record({maxEvents?}) defaults to the main maxEvents but owns a separate ring. Main-ring clear/eviction does not stop recording, and only one recording may be active. handle.stop returns IRpcDevtoolsRecord. Repeated stop or a stale handle fails with RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE; overlapping record fails with RECORD_ACTIVE. collector.close discards an unfinished recording and idempotently releases collector state without closing a business Peer. Closed query/stats/describe and controls reject with CLOSED; direct emit only increments ignoredAfterClose. exportRecord/importRecord remain pure codec entry points.

Attach devtools.service to a separate existing Peer's provide:{devtools:devtools.service}. Remote methods are devtools.describe/query/watch/stats/record.start/record.stop/clear/pause/resume; consume watch with Peer.stream. Service record.stop returns encoded text, unlike the local handle's record object. Content is hidden by default. Capture and exposeContent:true are separate decisions, with redaction and remote access authorization still owned by the application.

Service uses actual context.localEndpointId to exclude its serving endpoint from later ingestion and retained query/stats results. It does not drop legitimate business events merely named devtools.*. A separate service Peer keeps business endpoints observable. Remote watch cancellation uses the original stream signal. Service converts at the JSON/portable boundary: serialized Error chains and byte tags survive, undefined/functions and class prototypes do not, and BigInt becomes a string. This is not lossless arbitrary JS graph transfer. Conversion failure throws TypeError/SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID with the original cause.

RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat is {format:'migaia-rpc-devtools',version:1}. encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord returns UTF-8-compatible NDJSON: one header line, one event per following line, and a terminal newline. decodeRpcDevtoolsRecord accepts an optional terminal newline but rejects interior empty lines. Events require finite numeric seq/at and string endpointId/stage/direction. The codec neither sorts file order nor aligns timestamps. Invalid headers, versions, events, JSON, or byte tags fail with RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID/cause; no persistence resource is created.

ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array use {$bytes:base64}. At any event depth, a sole-key object of that shape is reserved v1 syntax decoded as Uint8Array; invalid or noncanonical Base64 is rejected. To preserve an ordinary object with that shape, store its JSON.stringify text and JSON.parse it after import. There is no automatic escaping or general lossless content:unknown graph guarantee.

Record.error accepts native Error or serialized IRpcWireError. Encoding reuses the RPC error codec to preserve source/code/name/message/stack/cause and aggregate members, normalizing already-serialized errors. Decoding restores native Errors without regenerating stacks. Service wire event.error stays serialized; Hub offline import converts restored Errors back through that same wire owner.

blocks.text: addTarget(name,client) requires a nonempty unique name and an existing request/stream client. Hub calls request('describe'/'query'/'stats') and stream('watch') without creating connections. If the service uses nested devtools.* paths, map them at the supplied client boundary rather than creating another Peer inside Hub.

Alignment takes five sequential describe samples and selects the smallest RTT: offset=remoteNow-(t0+t1)/2, uncertaintyMs=RTT/2, alignedAt=event.at-offset. This assumes symmetric delay and is not an error-free clock. Custom samples must share their events' clock domain; one sample cannot align mixed domains. Realignment commits only after all samples succeed and updates retained timeline wrappers, so previously returned references can observe new alignedAt values.

Initialization starts the sole watch's first read before paginated historical catch-up at 1000 events per page, then consumes that already-started watch and deduplicates by seq. It retains the collector's existing bounded queue. status/on('status') use connecting/connected/disconnected/offline/removed lifecycle values rather than error codes. Omitting the status name returns a new status Map. on('event') delivers stored wrappers as events arrive; a listener failure is reported without skipping later listeners.

timeline({targets,stages,trace,method,from,to,limit}) applies no filters by default. from/to use aligned time. limit is a nonnegative safe integer; 0 returns nothing. Ordered target rings are checked then k-way merged. Valid nonmonotonic events are fully sorted before limit. Global ordering is alignedAt, target name, then seq, without changing source file order or event identity.

interactions(trace?) associates explicit traces and (senderId,messageId) rather than automatically propagating trace. oneSided follows request/response business-role evidence, not target count: two endpoints inside one target can prove both sides, while repeated caller recordings cannot manufacture the provider side. Hub infers no missing events and replays no business calls. stats(name) forwards a live target's original result. stats() sums counts and histogram buckets before calculating percentiles rather than averaging p50/p95/p99. Existing maxima survive; missing legacy maxima are not invented.

importRecord(name,text) creates a readonly offline target with alignedAt=original at and uncertaintyMs=undefined; recorded offsets are not restored. Record v1 contains no cumulative stats, so offline stats is {since:0,methods:[]} and aggregate queries invent no offline counts. timeline/interactions arrays reuse stored wrappers and internal events; detail/error/untransferred content remain references. Do not mutate readonly query results. The codec is the independent text-representation boundary.

carrierSeq refers only to a carrier row in the same collector/target. At read boundaries, Collector translates Core-local ordinals using origins retained by the main ring, recording, and watch windows; it maintains no additional ingestion-time generation history. An origin evicted everywhere before first resolution cannot be recovered. Known links survive while their dependent rows remain. A cold read detecting source-sequence reset records the old origin's cutoff, preventing old rows from associating with a new generation while retaining known historical links.

After real decode supplies identity, Hub incrementally attaches same-target anonymous protected/frame/carrier rows to the interaction without mutating the original wire event or using another target's matching seq. Eviction also removes interaction/trace indexes. Some anonymous preceding chunks still cannot all be attributed. Repository carriers emit synchronously inside send; third-party asynchronous emit has no outbound context. Native Peer does not automatically propagate application trace; pass it explicitly from the application's own Endpoint.send. Frame/nested transfer content remains referenced, detail.drainMs may update after native drain, and top-level snapshots do not deep-copy it.

Duplicate names fail with TARGET_DUPLICATE, unknown names with TARGET_UNKNOWN, and repeated removal of an already-removed name is harmless. removeTarget invalidates the target and clears indexes before awaiting iterator.return; release failure is reported and rejected unchanged. Reentrant close joins owned pending removal cleanup without repeating return. Late describe/watch results cannot revive a removed target.

Describe/query initialization failure marks disconnected, reports and rejects addTarget with the original error, and releases an acquired watch without replacing the primary failure with cleanup errors. A running watch failure reports and retains received events without automatic retry; synchronous next failure cannot publish a later connected state. Hub.close immediately seals new operations, shares one Promise, and releases owned watches. Failures form a registration-ordered TARGET_RELEASE_FAILED AggregateError whose cause/errors[0] is the first original; it is reported before close resolves. Hub never closes the supplied client/Peer. Public calls after closure fail with CLOSED except repeated close.

createRpcLogProbe(logger,options?) requires complete debug/info/warn/error(message,fields) methods without depending on @migaia/logger. Default stages=['message','peer']; only these stages are supported here. Core compiles methods/sample using the same domains. capture/redact use the original emitter boundary. content defaults to false; content:true conveniently requests capture for subscribed stages, while explicit capture takes precedence. slowMs defaults to undefined, skipping normal settled calls; a finite nonnegative threshold, including 0, records settled durationMs≥slowMs as slow.

levels overrides failed/rejected/timeout/aborted/slow/lifecycle with debug/info/warn/error/off. Defaults are failed→error, rejected/timeout/aborted/slow→warn, lifecycle→info. timeout/aborted are derived from failure identity, not extra outcome literals. Optional message(view) replaces module category messages only for qualifying events; onError defaults to the host reporter.

The probe synchronously extracts independent fields: method/messageId/senderId/targetId/trace/durationMs/outcome/kind/rejection/lifecycle/peerId/error. It does not pass a reusable view to asynchronous logging, but error and explicit content remain references rather than deep snapshots. Each qualifying event invokes one logger method synchronously. A throw or thenable rejection goes to onError without changing business results; reporter failures go to the host reporter. The asynchronous logger path observes thenables without introducing Promises into ordinary collector business ingestion.

Logger methods must enqueue without blocking. This module creates no extra buffer, batcher, file writer, lock, rotation, or flush. With @migaia/logger, combine level/batch/file and explicitly choose asyncOutput:true, then let the application await flush/shutdown. Node file defaults to asynchronous append with directories created by the application; other hosts need their file capability. Directly importing those entries requires directly installing that module, but the log probe does not require it.
RPC_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/devtools; use RpcDevtoolsErrorCode with source rather than matching messages.

sections.heading: Keep recent RPC events without losing cumulative call counts

blocks.text: Long-running diagnostics need recent events, but the total call count must not disappear when older events leave the screen.
Using one bounded event list as the source of every statistic makes cumulative counts shrink whenever old entries are evicted.
Attach the collector through probePlugin to a real Endpoint; maxEvents bounds query retention while stats keeps completed method counts separately.

The example overrides the default 10000-event ring with capacity 2 and selects message events only. Aggregates survive eviction until clear; this is a retention guarantee, not a total process-memory bound.

collector.stages selects only message here instead of the message/peer default. maxEvents is 2 rather than 10000. query.methods=['double'] selects actual method-bearing rows and limit=2 overrides 1000. The public memory pair is a real transport. Endpoint ids are client/server with left/right transports; connect uses its Endpoint's transport and probePlugin installs devtools. provider.double reads context.data and returns twice it with success; send supplies target, method, and data. Without timeout middleware, Core uses its 1000 ms fallback. Endpoint disposal leaves the borrowed pair open; left.close finally closes both sides.

blocks.text: An operator clears a noisy live view while a recording window must keep the evidence collected before that reset.
Sharing the same storage for display and recording lets a harmless UI reset erase the investigation data.
Start record with its own capacity, observe a real request, and clear the main collector before stopping and exporting that recording.

Endpoint and probe installation match the preceding example. record.maxEvents defaults to the main capacity, here overridden from 2 to 64. echo returns payload 42. clear resets the main ring/statistics without stopping recording. A successful recording.stop consumes its active ownership. exportRecord/importRecord only encode/decode v1 without file I/O. finally separately closes Endpoints, collector, and memory pair.

sections.heading: Round-trip captured bytes and a native error chain

blocks.text: An offline diagnostic file must retain byte payloads and the cause behind a failed operation.
Ordinary JSON turns typed bytes into object fields and loses non-enumerable Error properties, leaving the imported incident incomplete.
Encode the full v1 record with encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord and decode it through the matching codec, which handles reserved byte tags and the native error graph.

blocks.text: The output is true true, true, then 1,2,3: decoding restores the native Error and TypeError cause, keeps the recorded stack, and restores the byte values.

The codec transforms an offline representation and performs no file I/O. A sole $bytes object is reserved v1 syntax; arbitrary objects, prototypes, and functions do not have a general lossless round-trip guarantee.

record.header uses RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat. Each event requires finite numeric seq/at and string endpointId/stage/direction. content contains bytes [1,2,3], and error is a native Error with its original cause. Object.defineProperties adds example diagnostic source/code without granting control authority. The encoder/decoder each take one input. Restored Errors retain recorded stacks rather than original object identity.

Taking two rows before sorting can return a later event while silently excluding an earlier retained one.

sections.heading: Mark missing interaction sides instead of inventing them

blocks.text: Two diagnostic files may contain opposite sides of one call, while a missing file leaves only one side visible.
Joining solely by method name can combine unrelated calls, and filling the missing side creates evidence that was never observed.
The hub correlates explicit senderId and messageId with trace filtering; removing a target updates that same retained interaction index.

blocks.code:
import { createRpcDevtoolsHub } from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/hub'
import * as format from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/contract'

const outbound = {
  seq: 1,
  at: 10,
  endpointId: 'client',
  stage: 'message',
  direction: 'outbound',
  kind: 'request',
  senderId: 'client',
  messageId: 'call-1',
  method: 'load',
  trace: 'trace-1'
}
const inbound = { ...outbound, at: 11, endpointId: 'server', direction: 'inbound' }
const encode = (event: typeof outbound) =>
  format.encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord({ header: format.RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat, events: [event] })
const hub = createRpcDevtoolsHub()
try {
  hub.importRecord('caller', encode(outbound))
  console.log(hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)
  hub.importRecord('provider', encode(inbound))
  const interaction = hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]
  console.log(interaction?.oneSided, interaction?.targets.join(','))
  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  console.log(hub.status('provider'), hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)
} finally {
  await hub.close()
}

Only retained request/response roles establish observed sides. The hub propagates no trace and starts no business request; a successfully removed target can be removed again without recreating it.

Both records share senderId=client, messageId=call-1, and trace=trace-1; endpointId and direction establish caller/provider roles. A matching method name alone is insufficient. Hub imports caller/provider, and interactions(trace) filters retained evidence. removeTarget(provider) clears indexes before joining owned watch cleanup; this offline example owns no remote watch. Repeating successful removal is harmless.

sections.heading: Redact real RPC log fields while isolating a failing sink

blocks.text: Diagnostics need selected RPC content, but logging must not expose the original data or change a successful business result.
Keeping a reusable probe view lets later events overwrite queued fields, while an uncaught logger error can disrupt the caller.
Install createRpcLogProbe through the real Core emitter with capture, redact and onError; it extracts fields synchronously and reports sink failures separately.

blocks.text: The output is 42, true true, true, true true: the request succeeds, qualified logs contain the redacted object, each field object is separate, and every sink failure is reported by original identity.

slowMs defaults to undefined, so normal settled calls are omitted; this example uses 0 to include them. Capture is off by default, redaction replaces content by reference, and buffering or external I/O belongs to the sink.

The logger supplies all four methods. warn retains each independent fields object and throws the same failure; onError retains that exact exception. stages is message, capture explicitly enables message rather than its default absence, and slowMs=0 includes successful calls that undefined normally omits. redact returns the same masked object by reference. With no levels override, slow maps to warn. The real Endpoint's probePlugin connects the probe to Core; no event view is fabricated, and echo still returns 42.

Hub accepts existing service clients or offline records; it creates no connections, reconnection supervisor, or business retries. The log probe selects events and extracts fields while the logger owns buffering and output. This workspace-private module has rpc-core/rpc-contract peer dependencies that consumers should declare directly. There is no runtime module-version equality check. blocks.text: Invalid options use this module's INVALID_OPTION TypeError. Actual allocation still depends on host memory. Logical message/peer events are the defaults; physical frames are not implicitly recorded, and ingestion has no separate sync/async mode.

emit(view) consumes top-level metadata into owned raw columns before returning. Strings retain references; the reusable emitter view is not retained. Ingestion performs no name interning, refcount work, carrier-sequence translation, or per-watcher enqueue. Query, watch delivery, stats, record.stop, export, and service boundaries derive names, associations, and wire representations when needed. Never hand a reusable view to asynchronous processing.

Optional message/envelope variation preserves the original route subtype, including ping, pong, close, abort, and registered user names. abort has kind cancel; other variations are control. Request/response and other stages omit it, while query/watch/wire/record codecs retain it.

detail, error, and captured content that was not actually transferred remain references; later mutation can affect reads. snapshotProbeEvent copies only top-level metadata rather than deep-copying those values. Content charges use UTF-8 string length, ArrayBuffer/View.byteLength, or an opaque object's supplied view.sizeBytes. Unknown opaque sizeBytes=-1 costs 0 without traversing or encoding its graph. Recording/watch references are outside the main-ring budget, so maxContentBytes is not a process-wide, cross-window, or arbitrary-object-graph memory bound.

query(input?) returns {events,nextSeq,counters} after one retained-ring scan. nextSeq is the next afterSeq cursor, not an array index. Counters are evicted, contentDropped, droppedReentrant, sampledOut, ignoredWhilePaused, ignoredAfterClose, and internOverflow, recording retention loss, content loss, reentry, sampling, lifecycle ignores, and name overflow.

blocks.text: Construction methods filter ingestion. Query/watch methods match actual method-bearing rows, so a reader method filter excludes methodless control events. When the reader name table fills, new names use overflow id 0 and increment internOverflow; existing names remain readable. maxInterned does not bound cumulative raw endpoint/method keys, which survive until clear and can grow as unique combinations grow.

Only settled/failed/rejected message events containing a method and nonnegative durationMs synchronously update stats, once per qualifying event. Per-endpoint/method calls, failed, rejected, timedOut, and aborted counts survive main-ring eviction. failed includes every outcome=failed event, while timedOut/aborted add separate classifications, so those counters are not disjoint categories to sum into total calls. Latency uses 24 log2 buckets at 0.0625 ms×2^k, k=0..23. Percentiles interpolate inside buckets; the terminal bucket is open above latencyOverflowFromMs=262144 ms, and p50/p95/p99 are clamped to observed latencyMaxMs. There is no fixed-width terminal-bucket error guarantee. describe.now and Core event at use monotonic milliseconds by default, whereas stats.since is wall time.

pause saves current stages and clears the emitter mask; repeated pause does not overwrite that choice. resume restores it, including stages set after construction. Direct emit during pause increments ignoredWhilePaused. clear resets the main ring, cumulative stats, and loss counters without ending independent recording/watch ownership; sequence numbers remain collector-owned.

watch(input?) omits afterSeq/limit and activates a consumer on first next. Active watchers share a 16384-row raw pending window. Each synchronous burst schedules at most one microtask notification; no active watchers means no notification. The raw window retains rows before notification applies each watcher's filters. Batches contain at most 256 events, with at most 64 queued batches per consumer; overflow drops the oldest batch. In {events,dropped}, dropped combines pre-filter raw overwrite and post-filter consumer batch loss, so it cannot reconstruct exact filter-matching loss.

Raw loss is assigned to watchers active at notification time. A watcher whose first next occurs after a burst was scheduled but before delivery can see pre-subscription raw loss. This is a current source limitation rather than a promise of exact post-subscription accounting. iterator.return wakes its own pending next and ends normally without closing the collector; collector.close terminates waiting watches with CLOSED.

record({maxEvents?}) defaults to the main maxEvents but owns a separate ring. Main-ring clear/eviction does not stop recording, and only one recording may be active. handle.stop returns IRpcDevtoolsRecord. Repeated stop or a stale handle fails with RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE; overlapping record fails with RECORD_ACTIVE. collector.close discards an unfinished recording and idempotently releases collector state without closing a business Peer. Closed query/stats/describe and controls reject with CLOSED; direct emit only increments ignoredAfterClose. exportRecord/importRecord remain pure codec entry points.

Attach devtools.service to a separate existing Peer's provide:{devtools:devtools.service}. Remote methods are devtools.describe/query/watch/stats/record.start/record.stop/clear/pause/resume; consume watch with Peer.stream. Service record.stop returns encoded text, unlike the local handle's record object. Content is hidden by default. Capture and exposeContent:true are separate decisions, with redaction and remote access authorization still owned by the application.

Service uses actual context.localEndpointId to exclude its serving endpoint from later ingestion and retained query/stats results. It does not drop legitimate business events merely named devtools.*. A separate service Peer keeps business endpoints observable. Remote watch cancellation uses the original stream signal. Service converts at the JSON/portable boundary: serialized Error chains and byte tags survive, undefined/functions and class prototypes do not, and BigInt becomes a string. This is not lossless arbitrary JS graph transfer. Conversion failure throws TypeError/SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID with the original cause.

RpcDevtoolsRecordFormat is {format:'migaia-rpc-devtools',version:1}. encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord returns UTF-8-compatible NDJSON: one header line, one event per following line, and a terminal newline. decodeRpcDevtoolsRecord accepts an optional terminal newline but rejects interior empty lines. Events require finite numeric seq/at and string endpointId/stage/direction. The codec neither sorts file order nor aligns timestamps. Invalid headers, versions, events, JSON, or byte tags fail with RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID/cause; no persistence resource is created.

ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array use {$bytes:base64}. At any event depth, a sole-key object of that shape is reserved v1 syntax decoded as Uint8Array; invalid or noncanonical Base64 is rejected. To preserve an ordinary object with that shape, store its JSON.stringify text and JSON.parse it after import. There is no automatic escaping or general lossless content:unknown graph guarantee.

Record.error accepts native Error or serialized IRpcWireError. Encoding reuses the RPC error codec to preserve source/code/name/message/stack/cause and aggregate members, normalizing already-serialized errors. Decoding restores native Errors without regenerating stacks. Service wire event.error stays serialized; Hub offline import converts restored Errors back through that same wire owner.

blocks.text: addTarget(name,client) requires a nonempty unique name and an existing request/stream client. Hub calls request('describe'/'query'/'stats') and stream('watch') without creating connections. If the service uses nested devtools.* paths, map them at the supplied client boundary rather than creating another Peer inside Hub.

Alignment takes five sequential describe samples and selects the smallest RTT: offset=remoteNow-(t0+t1)/2, uncertaintyMs=RTT/2, alignedAt=event.at-offset. This assumes symmetric delay and is not an error-free clock. Custom samples must share their events' clock domain; one sample cannot align mixed domains. Realignment commits only after all samples succeed and updates retained timeline wrappers, so previously returned references can observe new alignedAt values.

Initialization starts the sole watch's first read before paginated historical catch-up at 1000 events per page, then consumes that already-started watch and deduplicates by seq. It retains the collector's existing bounded queue. status/on('status') use connecting/connected/disconnected/offline/removed lifecycle values rather than error codes. Omitting the status name returns a new status Map. on('event') delivers stored wrappers as events arrive; a listener failure is reported without skipping later listeners.

timeline({targets,stages,trace,method,from,to,limit}) applies no filters by default. from/to use aligned time. limit is a nonnegative safe integer; 0 returns nothing. Ordered target rings are checked then k-way merged. Valid nonmonotonic events are fully sorted before limit. Global ordering is alignedAt, target name, then seq, without changing source file order or event identity.

interactions(trace?) associates explicit traces and (senderId,messageId) rather than automatically propagating trace. oneSided follows request/response business-role evidence, not target count: two endpoints inside one target can prove both sides, while repeated caller recordings cannot manufacture the provider side. Hub infers no missing events and replays no business calls. stats(name) forwards a live target's original result. stats() sums counts and histogram buckets before calculating percentiles rather than averaging p50/p95/p99. Existing maxima survive; missing legacy maxima are not invented.

importRecord(name,text) creates a readonly offline target with alignedAt=original at and uncertaintyMs=undefined; recorded offsets are not restored. Record v1 contains no cumulative stats, so offline stats is {since:0,methods:[]} and aggregate queries invent no offline counts. timeline/interactions arrays reuse stored wrappers and internal events; detail/error/untransferred content remain references. Do not mutate readonly query results. The codec is the independent text-representation boundary.

carrierSeq refers only to a carrier row in the same collector/target. At read boundaries, Collector translates Core-local ordinals using origins retained by the main ring, recording, and watch windows; it maintains no additional ingestion-time generation history. An origin evicted everywhere before first resolution cannot be recovered. Known links survive while their dependent rows remain. A cold read detecting source-sequence reset records the old origin's cutoff, preventing old rows from associating with a new generation while retaining known historical links.

After real decode supplies identity, Hub incrementally attaches same-target anonymous protected/frame/carrier rows to the interaction without mutating the original wire event or using another target's matching seq. Eviction also removes interaction/trace indexes. Some anonymous preceding chunks still cannot all be attributed. Repository carriers emit synchronously inside send; third-party asynchronous emit has no outbound context. Native Peer does not automatically propagate application trace; pass it explicitly from the application's own Endpoint.send. Frame/nested transfer content remains referenced, detail.drainMs may update after native drain, and top-level snapshots do not deep-copy it.

Duplicate names fail with TARGET_DUPLICATE, unknown names with TARGET_UNKNOWN, and repeated removal of an already-removed name is harmless. removeTarget invalidates the target and clears indexes before awaiting iterator.return; release failure is reported and rejected unchanged. Reentrant close joins owned pending removal cleanup without repeating return. Late describe/watch results cannot revive a removed target.

Describe/query initialization failure marks disconnected, reports and rejects addTarget with the original error, and releases an acquired watch without replacing the primary failure with cleanup errors. A running watch failure reports and retains received events without automatic retry; synchronous next failure cannot publish a later connected state. Hub.close immediately seals new operations, shares one Promise, and releases owned watches. Failures form a registration-ordered TARGET_RELEASE_FAILED AggregateError whose cause/errors[0] is the first original; it is reported before close resolves. Hub never closes the supplied client/Peer. Public calls after closure fail with CLOSED except repeated close.

createRpcLogProbe(logger,options?) requires complete debug/info/warn/error(message,fields) methods without depending on @migaia/logger. Default stages=['message','peer']; only these stages are supported here. Core compiles methods/sample using the same domains. capture/redact use the original emitter boundary. content defaults to false; content:true conveniently requests capture for subscribed stages, while explicit capture takes precedence. slowMs defaults to undefined, skipping normal settled calls; a finite nonnegative threshold, including 0, records settled durationMs≥slowMs as slow.

levels overrides failed/rejected/timeout/aborted/slow/lifecycle with debug/info/warn/error/off. Defaults are failed→error, rejected/timeout/aborted/slow→warn, lifecycle→info. timeout/aborted are derived from failure identity, not extra outcome literals. Optional message(view) replaces module category messages only for qualifying events; onError defaults to the host reporter.

The probe synchronously extracts independent fields: method/messageId/senderId/targetId/trace/durationMs/outcome/kind/rejection/lifecycle/peerId/error. It does not pass a reusable view to asynchronous logging, but error and explicit content remain references rather than deep snapshots. Each qualifying event invokes one logger method synchronously. A throw or thenable rejection goes to onError without changing business results; reporter failures go to the host reporter. The asynchronous logger path observes thenables without introducing Promises into ordinary collector business ingestion.

Logger methods must enqueue without blocking. This module creates no extra buffer, batcher, file writer, lock, rotation, or flush. With @migaia/logger, combine level/batch/file and explicitly choose asyncOutput:true, then let the application await flush/shutdown. Node file defaults to asynchronous append with directories created by the application; other hosts need their file capability. Directly importing those entries requires directly installing that module, but the log probe does not require it.
RPC_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/devtools; use RpcDevtoolsErrorCode with source rather than matching messages.

blocks.text: 离线诊断文件既要保存字节载荷，也要保留失败操作背后的原始原因。
直接使用普通 JSON 会把类型化字节变成对象字段，并丢掉 Error 的不可枚举属性，导入后的事故信息因此不完整。
把完整 v1 记录交给 `encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord`，再用配套解码器读取，编解码器负责保留字节标签与原生错误图。

blocks.code:
true true
true
1,2,3

blocks.text: 输出 `true true`、`true`、`1,2,3`：解码还原 Error 及其 TypeError 原因，保留记录中的堆栈，并还原字节值。
编解码器只转换离线表示，不执行文件读写；单键 `$bytes` 对象属于 v1 保留语法，不保证任意对象、原型和函数都能无损往返。

import { createRpcDevtoolsHub } from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/hub'
import * as format from '@migaia/rpc-devtools/contract'

const outbound = {
  seq: 1,
  at: 10,
  endpointId: 'client',
  stage: 'message',
  direction: 'outbound',
  kind: 'request',
  senderId: 'client',
  messageId: 'call-1',
  method: 'load',
  trace: 'trace-1'
}

  console.log(hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)
  hub.importRecord('provider', encode(inbound))

  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  await hub.removeTarget('provider')
  console.log(hub.status('provider'), hub.interactions('trace-1')[0]?.oneSided)

}

outcome: Optional canonical event outcome name used by queries and settlement statistics.

method: Method path observed on the logical message; names originate from the caller method route.

variation: Original variation route observed on message or envelope stages, preserving the Core route vocabulary.

senderId: Originating sender identity supplied by the observed RPC message.

targetId: Destination identity supplied by the observed RPC routing envelope.

receiverId: Actual receiver identity supplied by the observed receive path, which may differ from a routing target.

peerId: Peer identity issued by the observed Core peer lifecycle path.

trace: Explicit application-provided trace carried by the observed message; native Peer calls do not automatically invent it.

sizeBytes: Observed byte count when the layer knows it; missing sizes are not substituted with zero.

chunk: Observed chunk position: index is the source chunk index and count is its source chunk count; values come from the Core event.
Absent when the event is not an observed chunk.
members: Observed batch member count supplied by the source event.

rejection: Package-local rejection reason from the observed provider boundary, distinguishing causes that share an error code.

blocks.text: 离线诊断文件既要保存字节载荷，也要保留失败操作背后的原始原因。
直接使用普通 JSON 会把类型化字节变成对象字段，并丢掉 Error 的不可枚举属性，导入后的事故信息因此不完整。
把完整 v1 记录交给 `encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord`，再用配套解码器读取，编解码器负责保留字节标签与原生错误图。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true
1,2,3

blocks.text: 输出 `true true`、`true`、`1,2,3`：解码还原 Error 及其 TypeError 原因，保留记录中的堆栈，并还原字节值。
编解码器只转换离线表示，不执行文件读写；单键 `$bytes` 对象属于 v1 保留语法，不保证任意对象、原型和函数都能无损往返。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
addTarget: Registers a unique live target, aligns its clock, starts its one watch read before querying history, then consumes the buffered watch with sequence deduplication. The client must expose bare describe/query/watch/stats method names.
addTarget.name: Nonempty application-chosen name, unique among current live and offline target registrations.
addTarget.client: Already connected IRpcDevtoolsTargetClient supplied by the caller. Adapt a namespaced remote Peer so bare service names reach collector.service.
Promise<void> after setup, retaining the caller client connection. Duplicate names use TARGET_DUPLICATE; invalid input uses INVALID_OPTION; setup failure marks disconnected and rejects with the original error after acquired watch rollback; independent cleanup failure is reported separately without replacing the primary.
removeTarget: Detaches target events and correlation synchronously, then awaits its original iterator return; repeated removal of the same known name is harmless.
removeTarget.name: Name chosen by the application in addTarget(name, client) or importRecord(name, text).
Promise<void> after watch release; original return failures are reported and reject. Never-registered names use TARGET_UNKNOWN.
importRecord: Decodes and validates a complete record before publishing a read-only offline target; uses zero offset and no clock uncertainty sample.
importRecord.name: Nonempty unique name selected by the importing application for this offline target.
importRecord.text: Version-one NDJSON from encodeRpcDevtoolsRecord or collector exportRecord.
No result; the offline target is registered. Invalid text uses RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID and duplicate names use TARGET_DUPLICATE.
status: Reads one target status or snapshots all target statuses, including names remembered as removed.
status.name: Optional name from addTarget or importRecord; omitted by default to request a readonly map of all names.
RpcDevtoolsTargetStatus or a new ReadonlyMap. Unknown individual names throw TARGET_UNKNOWN; closed hub throws CLOSED.
timeline: Sorts retained events globally by aligned timestamp, then target name and sequence. Ordered targets use a checked merge; legal nonmonotonic records use full sorting before limit. Returned elements are stored references and may be realigned later.
timeline.query: Optional IRpcDevtoolsTimelineQuery; omitted means all retained targets and times without a result limit.
Readonly array of IRpcDevtoolsTimelineEvent. Zero limit returns empty; invalid limit uses INVALID_OPTION and closed hub uses CLOSED.
interactions: Queries incrementally maintained interaction membership using observed sender/message identity and explicit traces. It does not infer missing caller or provider events.
interactions.trace: Optional explicit trace read from events or application propagation; omitted by default to return all retained interactions.
Readonly array of retained IRpcDevtoolsInteraction references; oneSided remains true until both logical sides are actually observed.
stats: Forwards one live target statistics result or aggregates histogram buckets across live targets. Offline version-one records carry no statistics payload.
stats.name: Optional registered target name; omission aggregates live target results, while a named offline target returns empty statistics.
Promise<IRpcDevtoolsStats>; request failures are reported and reject without inventing counts.
on: Adds a synchronous status or event observer. Status callbacks receive registered name and status; event callbacks receive the retained timeline wrapper. Listener throws are reported while other listeners continue.
on.event: Choose status for target lifecycle changes or event for accepted timeline items.
on.listener: Synchronous callback: (name, status) for status or (event) for event. Values come from hub registration and ingestion; no return is used, async callbacks are not awaited.
Idempotent unsubscribe function taking no arguments; close also releases all listener slots.
Observe every target lifecycle transition, including connection, disconnection, offline import and removal.
Observe each accepted retained timeline wrapper, without a replay of historical events.
close: Synchronously rejects new operations and detaches target state, then releases all watches concurrently. Each target release failure is reported in registration order as a native AggregateError with TARGET_RELEASE_FAILED, first cause and all original errors. Application client failures otherwise retain their original identity.
Same Promise<void> on repeated calls, resolved after releases and listener cleanup. Release errors are reported instead of rejecting this close promise; client connections stay caller-owned.

symbols.purpose: The application logger supplied to the log probe, with required debug, info, warn and error methods. The probe forwards matching RPC events to these methods. Each method runs with the original logger as its receiver, so it can use that logger's instance state. Each method should accept or queue its record promptly; the logger owns buffering and writing to its destination. The probe does not wait for a returned Promise to finish, but observes its rejection. A thrown error or rejection is passed to onError.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The application logger supplied to the log probe, with required debug, info, warn and error methods. The probe forwards matching RPC events to these methods. Each method runs with the original logger as its receiver, so it can use that logger's instance state. Each method should accept or queue its record promptly; the logger owns buffering and writing to its destination. The probe does not wait for a returned Promise to finish, but observes its rejection. A thrown error or rejection is passed to onError.
